usage: Used for the flower "蘭花"; it is a common countable noun when referring to one kind of orchid or orchids in general.
Often appears in gardening, flower shops, and home decoration talk. It sounds natural in everyday Cantonese.
Can be used with classifiers like 一盆蘭花 or 幾枝蘭花 depending on whether you mean a potted plant or cut flowers.
Neutral and very common. For beginner learners, it is best used as a simple plant name without any special grammar patterns.
